AaveV2InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V2 instance. Thin subclass of AaveV3InstancesMeta (same DataProvider ABI; pool resolved via getLendingPool()). The active instance set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is the instance ProtocolDataProvider). positionId derived on-chain = abi.encode(instance LendingPool, reserve); describePosition label = "<reserve symbol> position (<market id>)" (market id = LendingPool.getAddressesProvider().getMarketId(), e.g. "Aave genesis market"). Supersedes the per-instance AaveV2_* adapters, disabled below.

AaveV2_Mainnet.$superseded: Disabled — superseded by AaveV2InstancesMeta (ADR 0010). Instance still queried via metaInstances (its DataProvider).
AaveV2_Mainnet.comment: Aave V2 lending market (legacy). The V2 ProtocolDataProvider exposes the same getAllReservesTokens / getUserReserveData ABI as V3, covered by AaveV2InstancesMetaBalanceAdapter. Stable-debt positions are not reported — V2 stable borrowing has been governance-disabled across all reserves and any residual stable debt is rounding noise. Mainnet only: V2 was never deployed on the L2s/Gnosis this repo also targets.

AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V3 instance. The active instance set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is the instance ProtocolDataProvider). Supersedes the per-instance AaveV3_* adapters, disabled below. positionId derived on-chain = abi.encode(instance Pool, reserve); describePosition label = "<reserve symbol> position (<market id>)" (market id = Pool.ADDRESSES_PROVIDER().getMarketId(), e.g. "Aave Ethereum Market" vs "Aave V3 Lido Ethereum" — distinguishes Core/Lido instances that share a reserve symbol).

AaveV3SafetyModule.comment_legacy: Address of the previous single-token (stkGHO-only) adapter. The new multi-token adapter replaces it; once 04_DeployBalanceAdapters runs, the OIV Safe must call NAVCalculator.removeBalanceOracle(legacy_deployed) and addBalanceOracle(deployed) to swap them in. The set of stake tokens (stkAAVE, stkABPT, stkABPTv2, stkGHO) is hardcoded in the adapter's source — adding a new SM stake token in the future is a code change, not a config edit. See docs/decisions/0002-aave-safety-module-multi-token.md.

AaveUmbrella.comment: Dynamic-discovery adapter for Aave Umbrella stake tokens. The full stake-token set (stkwaEthUSDC.v1, stkwaEthUSDT.v1, stkwaEthWETH.v1, stkGHO.v1 today) is enumerated at runtime via RewardsController.getAllAssets(); each stake token's bare reserve is resolved by walking its ERC4626 asset() chain. The only address pinned in this adapter is the RewardsController above, passed via constructor and treated as the protocol's trust anchor. New stake tokens added by Aave governance are picked up automatically as long as their bare reserve is registered with NAVCalculator. See docs/decisions/0006-aave-umbrella-balance-oracle.md.

This SUPERSEDES the per-vault MorphoVault_* adapters, which are disabled below — the NAV calculator now learns the Morpho-vault universe from this list.

ERC4626Wrap_sGHO.$comment: Aave sGHO savings vault (ERC-4626). sGHO.asset() returns GHO; convertToAssets unwraps shares to GHO-equivalent. Held by the Alpha funds. At fork block 25230126, redeem() returned exactly convertToAssets() (no exit fee/cooldown), so convertToAssets does not over-report. Share price is >= 1 GHO (yield vault), not a 1:1 share/asset peg.

ERC4626Wrap_waEthLidoGHO.$comment: Aave V3 Lido instance stata-token wrap of aEthLidoGHO. waEthLidoGHO.asset() returns GHO; convertToAssets unwraps shares to GHO-equivalent. ACCOUNT_11 holds ~$233 of this token. Production adapter not deployed yet — integration test deploys it ephemerally from this config block. Run script/deploy/04_DeployBalanceAdapters.s.sol post-PR-merge to deploy and write the address back into `deployed`.

The active market set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is the market/pool address). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = market address; name = market name(). Supersedes the per-market GearboxMarket_* adapters, disabled below.

BalancerV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V3 pool's wallet-held (unstaked) AMM liquidity only. The active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is the pool/BPT address). Gauge-staked LP + rewards are the separate BalancerV3GaugesMeta adapter. positionId derived on-chain = the pool address; name = BPT token name(). Supersedes the per-pool BalancerV3_* adapters, disabled below.

BalancerV3GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V3 gauge's staked LP + BAL/extra rewards. The active gauge set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below — each entry is the gauge address). Wallet-held (unstaked) LP is the separate BalancerV3PoolsMeta adapter. positionId derived on-chain = the gauge address; name = the gauge's lp_token() BPT name(). Supersedes the per-pool BalancerV3_* adapters, disabled below.

BalancerV2PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V2 pool's wallet-held BPT, decomposed pro-rata into the underlying tokens (composable-stable BPT-in-pool token excluded; supply via getActualSupply() when present else totalSupply()). The instance coordinate is the raw 32-byte poolId (metaInstancesRaw below), NOT an address — the BPT address is derived on-chain as address(uint160(uint256(poolId) >> 96)). positionId derived on-chain = the BPT address; name = the BPT name(). Gauge-staked BPT is the separate BalancerV2GaugesMeta adapter. Disabled: no fund holds Balancer V2 positions today — the example instance is B-80BAL-20WETH, enable + add poolIds via setMetaInstancesRaw when a position is opened.

BalancerV2GaugesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Balancer V2 gauge's staked BPT (decomposed pro-rata like BalancerV2PoolsMeta) + claimable BAL and extra reward tokens. The instance coordinate is the gauge address (metaInstances below); the BPT is read on-chain via gauge.lp_token() and its poolId via getPoolId(). positionId derived on-chain = the gauge address; name = the gauge's lp_token() BPT name(). Wallet-held (unstaked) BPT is the separate BalancerV2PoolsMeta adapter. Disabled: no fund holds Balancer V2 gauge positions today — the example instance is the B-stETH-STABLE gauge, enable + add gauges via setMetaInstances when a position is opened.

KelpWithdrawalQueue.comment: Kelp DAO rsETH exit queue (LRTWithdrawalManager). Multi-asset: supported payout assets (stETH, ETHx, native ETH) discovered at runtime via lrtConfig().getSupportedAssetList(); positions emitted only for NAV-registered assets.

LidoWithdrawalQueue.comment: Lido WithdrawalQueueERC721. Single-asset, denominated in native ETH (the asset Lido pays on claim; priced via ETH/USD). Per open (un-claimed) request: finalized -> exact claimable ETH (getClaimableEther); not-yet-finalized -> amountOfStETH (estimate until finalization). underlyingToken is the ERC-7528 native sentinel.

MerklRewards.comment: Proof-cached unclaimed-rewards adapter (ADR 0007). Owner = chainConfig.admin (set at deploy time). Disabled by default — enable per chain when the off-chain proof-submission bot is in place. Distributor address is canonical across every supported EVM chain.

NonfungiblePositionManager pinned in the constructor; the active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (setMetaInstances, from metaInstances below). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = pool address; name = sym0/sym1 feeTier. Supersedes the per-pool UniswapV3_* adapters, disabled below.
